name: Unit turnover readiness checklist
summary: Between one tenant and the next, the property manager gets one page for the unit: every recorded repair, the cleaning, keys, utilities and vendor confirmations still open against the approved move-in date, each gap written as a question. Nothing is sent.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of property operations and tenant service, and its own rules for prepared work: the manager's records as the only authority, set column headings with a stop on a mismatch, every gap written as a question for a named role, and a person who verifies, approves and sends.
